title: Cleanup orphan Terraform state and unify environment overlays
creator: Asha Menon
description: We have several orphaned Terraform state files and an inconsistent overlay pattern across envs (staging, prod, preprod) that cause drift and post-deploy manual fixes. This ticket will: 1) audit and reconcile orphaned states in S3 backends, 2) introduce a single region-aware overlay abstraction to replace hand-rolled stage templates, 3) standardize backend locking (DynamoDB TTL and lock table schema), and 4) perform an AWS provider upgrade (v4 -> v5) in a controlled canary. Goal is to reduce drift noise, eliminate manual tfstate imports during deploys, and simplify future multi-region/private deployment automation.
comments: 2025-02-21 - Asha Menon: Initial scoping done. Found ~12 S3 keys with duplicate state files and 3 non-standard workspace names. Created confluence doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INFRA/pages/cleanup-terraform-state

2025-02-27 - Diego Ramos (review): Suggested using force-unlock only as last resort; prefer plan/apply with import where possible. Also called out the need to add preflight validator that verifies workspace naming convention.

2025-03-01 - Lena Park: Created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/987 to add backend migration scripts and a state-audit lambda. CI job added to run terraform fmt and validate on changes.
2025-03-03 - Ops: Performed snapshot of S3 state bucket and exported DynamoDB lock table; snapshot stored at s3://redwood-infra-backups/terraform/2025-03-03/
2025-03-04 - Lena Park: Completed dry-run for one staging workspace. No drift confirmed. Provider upgrade tested in a dedicated test org using aws provider v5 with zero-change plan on small modules.
2025-03-05 - Security (FYI): Confirmed no secrets are present in tfstate snapshots; KMS key was used for encrypted S3 bucket. No additional controls required for this ticket.
acceptance_criteria: All orphaned tfstate files reconciled or archived with documented justification
Overlay templates consolidated into a single region-aware module with clear inputs for envs
DynamoDB lock table schema standardized and TTL configured
Provider upgrade performed for core networking modules with no-prod-impact canary run
Deployment runbook updated with state-migration steps and rollback instructions
